claims.statement: Determine whether the published O1 collective construction admits an exact local parent using instantaneous local law coordinates, a bounded contextual jet, and retained memory, with original-time dynamics, the complete fixed protocol and records, and actual nonflat collective Fisher geometry; give a construction under explicit sufficiency conditions or a precisely scoped obstruction.
claims.quantifiers: Seek a realization for the published admitted C2 section class and every admitted finite adaptive history, at each fixed evaluation context, without retaining the whole contextual function. Explicitly distinguish a strictly germ-local retention from a finite-reference-memory realization, a local jet evaluation from a finite global encoding of arbitrary sections, and conditional finite-generator subfamilies. A scoped obstruction does not refute all allowed memory realizations.
claims.falsifier: Complete affirmative closure requires all locality, memory, normalization, dynamics, history and geometry conjuncts on the declared class. A finite-reference result or finite-generator family is conditional and does not settle strictly local realization on arbitrary published sections. A negative closure requires a nonexistence proof covering every allowed realization, not a failed jet ansatz.
